description: This PHP class defines the Style entity used in PhpSpreadsheet library, managing cell styles including properties like font, fill, borders, alignment, number format, protection, and style application logic.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Represents a cell style in PhpSpreadsheet, responsible for managing style components and applying style arrays to cells or ranges.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style properties from an array to the Style object or a range of cells if in supervisor mode.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a unique hash code representing the current style configuration for cache and comparison purposes.
